source_documents.name: MRIQC structural IQMs for shared spatial definitions

piesno_sigma.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate higher estimated noise in raw diffusion MRI data
caveats: interpret with SNR metrics and acquisition protocol

cc_snr.qc_interpretation: lower values may indicate poor diffusion signal quality in the corpus callosum
caveats: MRIQC can estimate worst-case and best-case SNR by diffusion shell

fa_nan.qc_interpretation: higher values indicate more not-a-number FA values within the brain mask
caveats: suggests model or data validity problems but needs visual and pipeline context

fa_degenerate.qc_interpretation: higher values indicate more invalid FA values outside the expected range
caveats: can reflect severe data or model-fitting problems

ndc.qc_interpretation: lower values may indicate poor diffusion image quality or low consistency between neighboring diffusion-weighted volumes
caveats: MRIQC notes values below about 0.4 can indicate poor quality

spikes_ppm.qc_interpretation: higher values indicate more voxels classified as signal spikes
caveats: inspect slice-wise spike metrics when available

cc_snr_*.display_name: Corpus Callosum Signal-to-Noise Ratio by Shell
cc_snr_*.qc_interpretation: lower values may indicate poor shell-specific diffusion signal quality in the corpus callosum
caveats: track whether value is worst-case or best-case SNR

noise_b0_*.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate greater estimated noise in b=0 volumes
caveats: interpret with PIESNO sigma and SNR

spikes_*.qc_interpretation: higher values indicate more slice-wise signal spiking
caveats: identify affected axis, slice, or volume when available

efc.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate ghosting, blurring, or motion-related degradation
caveats: shared spatial metric definition from structural IQMs

fber.qc_interpretation: lower values may indicate weak foreground signal relative to background noise
caveats: shared spatial metric definition from structural IQMs

fwhm_*.qc_interpretation: higher values may indicate spatial blurring or reduced sharpness
caveats: interpret with acquisition resolution and preprocessing context

snr.qc_interpretation: lower values may indicate poor diffusion image signal quality
caveats: prefer diffusion-specific SNR metrics when available

summary_*.qc_interpretation: describes image intensity distributions; useful for derived checks but weak as direct model evidence
caveats: usually only send if flagged or summarized

size_*.qc_interpretation: describes image dimensions; useful for comparability but not direct artifact evidence
caveats: do not use as QC failure evidence by itself

spacing_*.qc_interpretation: describes image resolution; useful for comparability but not direct artifact evidence
caveats: do not use as QC failure evidence by itself
